prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Every moving thing leaves a trail of three or four afterimages behind it, each copy split into pure red, green and blue and fading, like a long exposure lit by repeated coloured flashes; everything still stays sharp. Camera at the kerb, low and tilted. On a bandstand in a town square at night, a tall skinny man in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache throws up his arms in a magician's pose as a magnesium flash pops white in a cloud of smoke and the crowd turns to look; behind the smoke, at the edge of frame, a getaway car screeches away from the bank steps, money sacks in its open back windows, a police car swinging round after it. Light: the flash; strings of bulbs round the bandstand; wet cobbles streaked with every light. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
